description:
Convert your music to any format

MediaHuman Audio Converter is a free application for macOS and Windows. With it you can convert music in formats like MP3, AAC, WMA, OGG, etc. as well as in lossless formats like FLAC, Apple Lossless, AIFF, WAV (up to 32 bit).
- added trimming: convert only a selected part of a track, with waveform, playback preview and precise time entry
- added checksum files (.md5, .ffp, .st5) for lossless output
- added a Start button on each file in the list
- added an option to remove empty folders left after source files are deleted
- added support for album art saved by Windows Media Player next to the tracks
- fixed a damaged source file reported as successfully converted
- [win] fixed conversion slowing down when the app is minimized or in the background on Windows 11
- fixed volume normalization silently skipped when fade in/out is enabled
- [win] fixed volume normalization skipped for files with non-English characters in the path
- fixed conversion failing for some WAV files
- fixed random crashes while reading and writing tags
- fixed extra duplicate tags written when converting between formats
- fixed genre, comment and disc number from CUE sheets not carried over to converted tracks
- fixed CUE sheets of some audiobooks not split automatically
- fixed 'Choose CUE file' menu action doing nothing
- fixed embedded album art replaced by an online or folder cover
- fixed album art not shown by some players after conversion
- fixed removing a file during conversion leaving its conversion running
- fixed settings changes not reverted by Cancel
- fixed profile editor resetting AAC VBR mode, MP3 sample rate and lossless bit depth
- fixed pasting the license key from the purchase email
- fixed a downloaded update failing to install without any message
- [win] fixed the 64-bit installer refusing to install on Arm-based Windows 11
- [win] fixed the app not starting on computers with outdated graphics drivers
- [win] improved screen reader support in the 64-bit version
- improved appearance of icons and dialogs on high-resolution displays
- improved the update process: an already downloaded installer is reused
- improved error message when there is not enough free space on the disk
- extended loudness normalization range down to -40 LUFS
- updated audio codecs to latest versions
- minor improvements for stability
